source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.3

data.summary: While this model leads a unit, you may use the **[Insane Bravery](vsdata:ability/core.insane-bravery)** Stratagem on that unit for 0CP, even if it has already been used on another of your units this phase. Each use of this ability destroys a Bodyguard model of that unit.
